say:2:1630427001:0.text: Oh, friend, there's a whole science to it!
say:2:1630427001:0.source_cn: 朋友，这里面可有着大学问呢。
say:2:1630427001:0.male: Oh, friend, there's a whole science to it!
say:2:1630427001:0.female: Oh, friend, there's a whole science to it!

say:3:1630427002:0.text: I chalk it up to vocal quality, baa. Squirrels just have naturally prettier voices.
say:3:1630427002:0.source_cn: 我认为还是嗓音的原因吧，咩。毕竟松鼠的声音本身就要比乌...
say:3:1630427002:0.male: I chalk it up to vocal quality, baa. Squirrels just have naturally prettier voices.
say:3:1630427002:0.female: I chalk it up to vocal quality, baa. Squirrels just have naturally prettier voices.

say:4:1630427003:0.source_cn: 这是得到我们一致认同的结果，咩——

say:5:1630427004:0.text: If you've ever heard a crow sing, you'd agree with us in a heartbeat.
say:5:1630427004:0.source_cn: 如果你听过乌鸦唱歌，就会同意我们的看法了。
say:5:1630427004:0.male: If you've ever heard a crow sing, you'd agree with us in a heartbeat.
say:5:1630427004:0.female: If you've ever heard a crow sing, you'd agree with us in a heartbeat.

say:6:1630427005:0.text: It's so jarring, it's like hearing your human chainsaw their own house by accident.
say:6:1630427005:0.source_cn: 那真的很夸张，就像主人不小心把电锯砍在他自己的房子上了一样。
say:6:1630427005:0.male: It's so jarring, it's like hearing your human chainsaw their own house by accident.
say:6:1630427005:0.female: It's so jarring, it's like hearing your human chainsaw their own house by accident.

say:7:1630427006:0.text: Wait, did our human actually do that?
say:7:1630427006:0.male: Wait, did our human actually do that?
say:7:1630427006:0.female: Wait, did our human actually do that?

say:8:1630427007:0.text: No, no... But he did once destroy Ranger's doghouse by mistake.
say:8:1630427007:0.source_cn: 没有。但他曾经不小心砍在了浪浪的小木屋上。
say:8:1630427007:0.male: No, no... But he did once destroy Ranger's doghouse by mistake.
say:8:1630427007:0.female: No, no... But he did once destroy Ranger's doghouse by mistake.

say:11:1630427009:0.text: Ranger's family! He's the dog our human adopted.
say:11:1630427009:0.source_cn: 浪浪也是我们的家人，他是主人收养的一只小狗。
say:11:1630427009:0.male: Ranger's family! He's the dog our human adopted.
say:11:1630427009:0.female: Ranger's family! He's the dog our human adopted.

say:12:1630427010:0.text: We've watched him grow up over the years, from a little pup to a big fluffy blockhead.
say:12:1630427010:0.source_cn: 我们看着他从一点点长成好大点，过去了好多年。
say:12:1630427010:0.male: We've watched him grow up over the years, from a little pup to a big fluffy blockhead.
say:12:1630427010:0.female: We've watched him grow up over the years, from a little pup to a big fluffy blockhead.

say:13:1630427011:0.text: He's probably nearby! You should go say hi, baa.
say:13:1630427011:0.source_cn: 他应该就在这附近，你可以找找看，咩。
say:13:1630427011:0.male: He's probably nearby! You should go say hi, baa.
say:13:1630427011:0.female: He's probably nearby! You should go say hi, baa.
